name: One-Time Secret Tunnel
description: One-time, never-stored, out-of-band credential pass-through. The agent never sees the value.

publicUrl.label: Public base URL
publicUrl.help: Public HTTPS base of the gateway, e.g. your Tailscale Funnel URL https://host.tailnet.ts.net. Leave blank to auto-detect Tailscale; falls back to localhost (only reachable on the gateway host).
